title: Malaysian Prime Minister’s visit: stringent traffic restrictions in Kozhikode on September 13
description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim is scheduled to arrive at the Kozhikode International Airport at 6.30 p.m. on Sunday. He will be at the Markaz from 7.30 p.m. to 9.30 p.m., where he will receive the first ‘Excellence Award’ instituted by the Sheikh Abubakr Foundation.
